{
  "summary": "Acme Freight is a software company founded in 2014 that provides a terminal operating system for mid-sized container ports. The company focuses on reliability and correctness, prioritizing these over shipping speed to prevent costly errors for their clients. Headquartered in Rotterdam, the team of 60 manages software that facilitates the movement of approximately 4 million containers annually.",
  "what_they_do": "Acme Freight builds a terminal operating system used by port operators to plan vessel stowage, schedule cranes, and bill customers, for which they receive payment via annual licenses.",
